targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS repos FROM (SELECT repo, argMax(language, ts) AS language, argMax(lines_of_code, ts) AS loc, argMax(line_coverage_pct, ts) AS cov, argMax(vuln_critical, ts) AS vc, argMax(vuln_high, ts) AS vh, argMax(secrets_found, ts) AS secrets, argMax(test_count, ts) AS tests, argMax(tests_failed, ts) AS failed FROM capstone.repo_measurements GROUP BY repo)

SELECT sum(loc) AS lines FROM (SELECT repo, argMax(language, ts) AS language, argMax(lines_of_code, ts) AS loc, argMax(line_coverage_pct, ts) AS cov, argMax(vuln_critical, ts) AS vc, argMax(vuln_high, ts) AS vh, argMax(secrets_found, ts) AS secrets, argMax(test_count, ts) AS tests, argMax(tests_failed, ts) AS failed FROM capstone.repo_measurements GROUP BY repo)

SELECT round(avg(cov), 1) AS avg_cov FROM (SELECT repo, argMax(language, ts) AS language, argMax(lines_of_code, ts) AS loc, argMax(line_coverage_pct, ts) AS cov, argMax(vuln_critical, ts) AS vc, argMax(vuln_high, ts) AS vh, argMax(secrets_found, ts) AS secrets, argMax(test_count, ts) AS tests, argMax(tests_failed, ts) AS failed FROM capstone.repo_measurements GROUP BY repo)

panels.title: Critical + high vulnerabilities
panels.description: Null when trivy was not available in the measure image.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(vc) + sum(vh) AS vulns FROM (SELECT repo, argMax(language, ts) AS language, argMax(lines_of_code, ts) AS loc, argMax(line_coverage_pct, ts) AS cov, argMax(vuln_critical, ts) AS vc, argMax(vuln_high, ts) AS vh, argMax(secrets_found, ts) AS secrets, argMax(test_count, ts) AS tests, argMax(tests_failed, ts) AS failed FROM capstone.repo_measurements GROUP BY repo)

panels.title: Planted bugs found (recall)
panels.description: Uses the answer key. Never expose the key to the agents: only this dashboard reads it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * (SELECT uniqExact(repo, planted_id) FROM capstone.issue_matches) / nullIf((SELECT count() FROM capstone.planted_issues), 0), 1) AS recall_pct

panels.title: Average coverage over time
panels.description: Averages every measurement in the bucket, including baselines of repos not yet touched: read the drilldown for per-repo truth.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, avg(line_coverage_pct) AS avg_line_coverage FROM capstone.repo_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND line_coverage_pct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT language, count() AS repos FROM (SELECT repo, argMax(language, ts) AS language, argMax(lines_of_code, ts) AS loc, argMax(line_coverage_pct, ts) AS cov, argMax(vuln_critical, ts) AS vc, argMax(vuln_high, ts) AS vh, argMax(secrets_found, ts) AS secrets, argMax(test_count, ts) AS tests, argMax(tests_failed, ts) AS failed FROM capstone.repo_measurements GROUP BY repo) GROUP BY language ORDER BY repos DESC

panels.title: Worst 15 repos (lowest coverage, then most vulnerabilities)

targets.rawSql: SELECT repo, language, round(cov, 1) AS coverage_pct, vc AS critical, vh AS high, secrets, failed AS tests_failed FROM (SELECT repo, argMax(language, ts) AS language, argMax(lines_of_code, ts) AS loc, argMax(line_coverage_pct, ts) AS cov, argMax(vuln_critical, ts) AS vc, argMax(vuln_high, ts) AS vh, argMax(secrets_found, ts) AS secrets, argMax(test_count, ts) AS tests, argMax(tests_failed, ts) AS failed FROM capstone.repo_measurements GROUP BY repo) ORDER BY cov ASC, vc DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT l.repo AS repo, round(f.cov, 1) AS baseline_pct, round(l.cov, 1) AS latest_pct, round(l.cov - f.cov, 1) AS gain_pct FROM (SELECT repo, argMax(language, ts) AS language, argMax(lines_of_code, ts) AS loc, argMax(line_coverage_pct, ts) AS cov, argMax(vuln_critical, ts) AS vc, argMax(vuln_high, ts) AS vh, argMax(secrets_found, ts) AS secrets, argMax(test_count, ts) AS tests, argMax(tests_failed, ts) AS failed FROM capstone.repo_measurements GROUP BY repo) AS l JOIN (SELECT repo, argMin(line_coverage_pct, ts) AS cov FROM capstone.repo_measurements WHERE iteration = 0 GROUP BY repo) AS f ON l.repo = f.repo ORDER BY gain_pct DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Cost per coverage point
panels.description: A repo with cost and zero gain has usd_per_point NULL: that is the signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.repo AS repo, round(sum(a.cost_usd), 2) AS cost_usd, round(any(g.gain), 1) AS gain_pct, round(sum(a.cost_usd) / nullIf(any(g.gain), 0), 2) AS usd_per_point FROM capstone.agent_runs AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT repo, argMax(line_coverage_pct, ts) - argMinIf(line_coverage_pct, ts, iteration = 0) AS gain FROM capstone.repo_measurements WHERE line_coverage_pct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY repo) AS g ON g.repo = a.repo GROUP BY a.repo ORDER BY usd_per_point DESC
SELECT outcome, count() AS runs FROM capstone.agent_runs GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY runs DESC
